feature: Automatic anonymous Funkwhale rescue after YouTube failure, canonical identity index and complete-file SHA before the existing single Audio, quality/codec selection among verified original encodings.

quality.policy: Prefer supported lossless, then codec-aware broad lossy quality tiers; compare bitrate within a codec. Only index-approved encodings are considered and the full file hash must match. Runtime metadata bitrate changes are rejected.
quality.multiEncodingChoiceTests: synthetic metadata/file fixtures in web-funkwhale and web-funkwhale-index tests

invariants: Local/downloaded audio, podcasts, explicitly added YouTube IDs and manual choices keep their priority.
Failed YouTube searches/streams may use verified Funkwhale without inferring that a recording is absent.
Funkwhale failure preserves existing Audius/video/error paths; source URLs are not written to library or queue.
The existing Audio, media session, seek/repeat and prepared-next pipeline are retained; playing and prepared Blob URLs are pinned.
Player changes cancel stale acquisitions without cancelling downloads; manual selection cancels an older same-track download and a download waits for a pending explicit choice.
Candidate/hash verification uses the complete CORS-readable body, and those exact bytes become the playback Blob.
Funkwhale offline downloads are not enabled; RAM copies are not persistent downloads.

controlledMedia.scope: 36 existing media scenarios and two setup checks per desktop engine. Synthetic HTTP providers and real browser Audio/IDB/service worker. Not an all-suite run, actual provider or physical phone proof.

officialVideoRegression.scope: Compiled UI with benign iframe/provider fixtures; not actual YouTube autoplay proof.

compiledRealFunkwhaleLocal.scope: Real compiled UI with actual catalog, Funkwhale bodies and complete-file hashes. Explicit YouTube network-failure injection reaches the fallback.
compiledRealFunkwhaleLocal.checks: Three canonical recordings, complete file/Blob SHA, single output Audio/no iframe, seek, hidden 10 seconds, navigation, prepared different-artist natural ended offline/hidden and real stale transport abortion.

update.scope: Desktop isolated real controlling service worker and explicit update; playlists/podcast state/downloaded fixture bytes preserved. No physical installation claim.

earlierUnpublishedCandidates.reason: Independent review found player cancellation also aborted pending downloads; fixed before publication.
Independent review found split download operations could overwrite or race an explicit same-track source choice; fixed before publication.

limits: Only three canonical recordings currently have generated identity proof. The generator is generic but the approved index is finite; names alone never authorize arbitrary catalog substitution.

Acoustic evidence compares approximately 30-second official excerpts plus distinct-song negatives; it does not authenticate the unreferenced remainder of a master or guarantee every remaster/medley distinction.
Physical installed Android/iPhone background, screen-off and codec behavior for these new provider paths remain unverified. Desktop hidden tabs and WebKit/Linux are separate evidence.
A public pod/development API may change schema, permissions or availability; the adapter rejects unreadable/changed/unsupported metadata and does not keep temporary signed storage URLs.
No whole commercial catalog or Epoitaitaye recovery is claimed.
No server, account, subscription, extension or native service is added. Android Auto/CarPlay native integrations remain outside this static PWA.
